profile.headline: Senior Full-Stack Software Developer
profile.summary:
Hello! I'm Kira, a Denver-based full stack developer with over 7+ years of experience in the industry. 

My current role at edX, whose mission is focused upon delivering education to all, has provided me not only with fast-paced technical challenges, but also a culture that combines new technology with human empathy. This has allowed me to further develop my skills in frontend development and become a well-rounded full stack engineer. 

Outside of work, I love to volunteer, watercolor, and fill my camera roll with pictures of my dog and cat.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Increased client-facing admin portal views by 24% by collaborating with UX and executing a complete visual and functional redesign to explore and customize edX’s subscription catalog

Delivered an automated onboarding experience that saved 250+ hours in manual onboarding time per year, empowered new customers, and reduced lift for internal support team 

Led months long, team wide epic to implement user groups and learner profiles for admins; wrote all tickets, re-architected Python/Django repos, and built new pages to see insights and organize users

Increased learner engagement by ~6% and boosted learner portal stickiness from 6% to 9% by implementing pre-query search functionality on the B2B course search page

Designed and implemented an AI assistant prototype for our learning platform; the prototype’s success led to the formation of a dedicated Artificial Intelligent team, resulting in widespread engagement of the Xpert chatbot from thousands of learners

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Developed code for Spring Java codebase that stores device information into graph database in Cassandra and JanusGraph through Gremlin and CQL queries as well as analyzing data and performance with Splunk and Amazon CloudWatch. I also created an automated Bash deployment script and implemented additional automated testing through Cucumber and Gherkin to ensure safe and consistent deployments for CI/CD.

positions.title: Software Development Intern
positions.description: Developed airline fare quote system, deployed both front-end and back-end enhancements using JavaScript, CSS, SQL, Spring MVC, and Java. Performed internal demos of the tool to various management teams and authored detailed documentation.

positions.title: Software Development Intern
positions.description: Created and revised test scripts and stress tests to ensure that disk drive firmware met unique customer specifications. Also updated the organization and uniformity of testing conditions and created a script to test the validity of a background media scan using an in-house variation of C.

positions.title: Teaching Assistant
positions.description: Demonstrated programming abilities through helping 140+ students in Java data structures course, evaluated and debugged code to ensure students had a strong understanding of course concepts.

honors.title: Computer Science Inclusion and Diversity Scholarship

volunteerExperiences.description: Dedicated over 100+ volunteer hours since joining with multiple organizations in the greater Boston area including Cradles to Crayons, the Prison Book Program, More than Words bookstore, along with various others.
Founded and taught a weekly Girls Who Code class for local students aged 11-18 to teach computer science skills and teamwork, with a goal to decrease the gender gap in technology and STEM.

projects.title: Raspberry Pi Parking Assistant
projects.description: Collaborated with two classmates to create a backup camera utilizing a Raspberry Pi. Our python code used the functionality of a webcam, a distance sensor, and the pi to create a parking assistant.

organizations.name: Alpha Phi Omega - Service Fraternity
organizations.description: Elected to serve as Public Relations Chair, organized and executed various service events for 80 other pledges and actives, controlled social media presence to maintain the face of the Epsilon Xi chapter, while volunteering over 60 hours a year throughout the community

organizations.name: ACM-W
organizations.description: Participated and attended various talks hosted by women who are leaders in the technological sector, also attended meet-and-greets with other peers and faculty in computer science
